title: Chapter4
description: Finnish vocabulary: food, groceries, shopping and the kitchen

questions.question: Time
questions.exampletranslate: I don't have time.

questions.question: Pineapple
questions.exampletranslate: I buy a fresh pineapple.

questions.question: Orange
questions.exampletranslate: I drink orange juice.

questions.question: To open / unlock
questions.explanation: 'Avata' (type 4 verb) means to open or unlock; 'avaan' is 'I open'.
questions.exampletranslate: I open the shop's door.

questions.question: Broiler / Chicken (meat)
questions.exampletranslate: I eat chicken and rice.

questions.question: Gram
questions.exampletranslate: I need a hundred grams of cheese.

questions.question: Cheap
questions.exampletranslate: This is a cheap shop.

questions.question: Identity card / ID
questions.explanation: 'Henkilöllisyystodistus' means identity card or ID; its genitive is 'henkilöllisyystodistuksen'.
questions.exampletranslate: I show my identity card.

questions.question: Blue cheese
questions.exampletranslate: I like blue cheese.

questions.question: Shelf
questions.exampletranslate: The bread is on the shelf.

questions.question: Quite / Completely
questions.explanation: 'Ihan' means quite, completely or right (as an intensifier).
questions.exampletranslate: I am quite tired.

questions.question: Minced meat / Ground meat
questions.exampletranslate: I make patties from minced meat.

questions.question: Queue / Line
questions.exampletranslate: There is a long queue at the checkout.

questions.question: Something
questions.exampletranslate: I want to buy something good.

questions.question: Party / Celebration
questions.explanation: 'Juhlat' means party or celebration; its genitive is 'juhlien'.
questions.exampletranslate: We have a party on Saturday.

questions.question: Cheese
questions.exampletranslate: I put cheese on the bread.

questions.question: Ice cream
questions.exampletranslate: In summer I eat a lot of ice cream.

questions.question: Cabbage
questions.exampletranslate: I make soup from cabbage.

questions.question: Cupboard / Cabinet
questions.explanation: 'Kaappi' means cupboard or cabinet; its genitive is 'kaapin'.
questions.exampletranslate: The plates are in the cupboard.

questions.question: Fish
questions.exampletranslate: We eat fish on Friday.

questions.question: Expensive
questions.exampletranslate: This car is too expensive.

questions.question: Chicken
questions.exampletranslate: I buy chicken from the shop.

questions.question: Egg
questions.exampletranslate: I need two eggs.

questions.question: Loyal / Regular customer
questions.explanation: 'Kanta-asiakas' means a loyal or regular customer; its genitive is 'kanta-asiakkaan'.
questions.exampletranslate: I am a loyal customer of this shop.

questions.question: Candy / Sweets
questions.explanation: 'Karkki' means candy or sweets; its genitive is 'karkin'.
questions.exampletranslate: The children eat candy on Saturday.

questions.question: Checkout / Cash register
questions.exampletranslate: I pay at the checkout.

questions.question: Bag / Tote
questions.explanation: 'Kassi' means a bag or tote (e.g. a shopping bag).
questions.exampletranslate: I put the food in the bag.

questions.question: Vegetable
questions.explanation: 'Kasvis' means vegetable; its genitive is 'kasviksen' (a synonym of 'vihannes').
questions.exampletranslate: I eat a lot of vegetables.

questions.question: Vegetarian (person)
questions.exampletranslate: I am a vegetarian.

questions.question: Shopping list
questions.exampletranslate: I make a shopping list before the shop.

questions.question: Soup
questions.exampletranslate: I make warm soup.

questions.question: Cream
questions.exampletranslate: I add cream to the soup.

questions.question: Hurry
questions.exampletranslate: I am in a big hurry.

questions.question: Kilogram
questions.exampletranslate: I buy a kilo of potatoes.

questions.question: Ham
questions.exampletranslate: I put ham on the bread.

questions.question: Cat food
questions.explanation: 'Kissanruoka' means cat food; its genitive is 'kissanruoan'.
questions.exampletranslate: I buy cat food for the cat.

questions.question: Whole / Entire
questions.explanation: 'Kokonainen' means whole or entire; its genitive is 'kokonaisen'.
questions.exampletranslate: I buy a whole loaf of bread.

questions.question: Card
questions.explanation: 'Kortti' means card (e.g. a bank card); its genitive is 'kortin'.
questions.exampletranslate: I pay by card.

questions.question: Receipt
questions.exampletranslate: May I have a receipt?

questions.question: Cucumber
questions.explanation: 'Kurkku' means cucumber (also throat); its genitive is 'kurkun'.
questions.exampletranslate: I put cucumber in the salad.

questions.question: Cold
questions.exampletranslate: The milk is cold.

questions.question: To ask
questions.explanation: 'Kysyä' (type 1 verb) means to ask; 'kysyn' is 'I ask'.
questions.exampletranslate: I ask the seller for the price.

questions.question: To walk
questions.explanation: 'Kävellä' (type 3 verb) means to walk; 'kävelen' is 'I walk'.
questions.exampletranslate: I walk to the shop.

questions.question: To use
questions.explanation: 'Käyttää' (type 1 verb) means to use; 'käytän' is 'I use'.
questions.exampletranslate: I use a card for paying.

questions.question: To put / prepare
questions.explanation: 'Laittaa' (type 1 verb) means to put or prepare (e.g. food); 'laitan' is 'I put'.
questions.exampletranslate: I make food in the evening.

questions.question: Lactose
questions.exampletranslate: This milk is without lactose.

questions.question: Bread
questions.exampletranslate: I buy fresh bread.

questions.question: Meat
questions.exampletranslate: I don't eat meat.

questions.question: Litre
questions.exampletranslate: I buy a litre of milk.

questions.question: Salmon
questions.exampletranslate: I eat fried salmon.

questions.question: Finally / In the end
questions.explanation: 'Lopuksi' means finally or in the end.
questions.exampletranslate: Finally I pay at the checkout.

questions.question: To shorten / reduce
questions.explanation: 'Lyhentää' (type 1 verb) means to shorten or reduce; 'lyhennän' is 'I shorten'.
questions.exampletranslate: I shorten the text.

questions.question: Near / Nearby
questions.explanation: 'Lähellä' means near or nearby (used with the genitive).
questions.exampletranslate: The shop is near home.

questions.question: Warm
questions.exampletranslate: The soup is warm.

questions.question: Sweet
questions.exampletranslate: This juice is too sweet.

questions.question: Sausage
questions.exampletranslate: I grill sausage in summer.

questions.question: Spice / Seasoning
questions.explanation: 'Mauste' means spice or seasoning; its genitive is 'mausteen'.
questions.exampletranslate: I add spices to the food.

questions.question: Juice
questions.exampletranslate: I drink apple juice.

questions.question: What price / How much (does it cost)
questions.explanation: 'Minkä hintainen' asks what price something is, i.e. how much it costs.
questions.exampletranslate: What price is this?

questions.question: Plastic
questions.exampletranslate: The bottle is made of plastic.

questions.question: Plastic bag
questions.exampletranslate: I take one plastic bag.

questions.question: To change
questions.explanation: 'Muuttua' (type 1 verb) means to change or become; 'muutun' is 'I change'.
questions.exampletranslate: The weather is changing cold.

questions.question: Seller / Salesperson
questions.exampletranslate: The salesperson helps the customer.

questions.question: Cattle / Beef
questions.explanation: 'Nauta' means cattle, and naudanliha is beef; its genitive is 'naudan'.
questions.exampletranslate: I buy beef.

questions.question: Apple
questions.exampletranslate: I eat an apple as a snack.

questions.question: Purchase
questions.explanation: 'Ostos' means a purchase; the plural 'ostokset' means shopping; its genitive is 'ostoksen'.
questions.exampletranslate: I do the shopping on Saturday.

questions.question: Shopping cart / Trolley
questions.explanation: 'Ostoskärry' means shopping cart or trolley; its genitive is 'ostoskärryn'.
questions.exampletranslate: I put the food in the shopping cart.

questions.question: To weigh / press
questions.explanation: 'Painaa' (type 1 verb) means to weigh or to press; 'painan' is 'I weigh/press'.
questions.exampletranslate: How much does this weigh?

questions.question: Roast
questions.exampletranslate: On Sunday we eat a roast.

questions.question: To pack
questions.explanation: 'Pakata' (type 4 verb) means to pack; 'pakkaan' is 'I pack'.
questions.exampletranslate: I pack the shopping into a bag.

questions.question: Package / Packet
questions.explanation: 'Paketti' means package or packet; its genitive is 'paketin'.
questions.exampletranslate: I buy a packet of coffee.

questions.question: Package / Packaging
questions.explanation: 'Pakkaus' means a package or packaging; its genitive is 'pakkauksen'.
questions.exampletranslate: Read the instructions on the package.

questions.question: Deposit / Pawn
questions.explanation: 'Pantti' means a deposit (e.g. a bottle deposit) or pawn; its genitive is 'pantin'.
questions.exampletranslate: You get the deposit back from the bottle.

questions.question: Bell pepper / Paprika
questions.exampletranslate: I put red bell pepper in the salad.

questions.question: Bar (e.g. snack bar)
questions.explanation: 'Patukka' means a bar, such as a chocolate or snack bar; its genitive is 'patukan'.
questions.exampletranslate: I eat a chocolate bar.

questions.question: Traditional
questions.exampletranslate: This is a traditional Finnish food.

questions.question: Potato
questions.exampletranslate: I boil potatoes.

questions.question: Pepper (spice)
questions.exampletranslate: I add salt and pepper to the food.

questions.question: Long / Tall
questions.exampletranslate: There is a long queue at the checkout.

questions.question: Carrot
questions.exampletranslate: The carrot is orange.

questions.question: Bag (small / paper)
questions.explanation: 'Pussi' means a bag (often a small or paper bag).
questions.exampletranslate: I buy a bag of candy.

questions.question: Box / Carton
questions.explanation: 'Rasia' means a small box or carton.
questions.exampletranslate: I buy a carton of strawberries.

questions.question: Fat-free
questions.exampletranslate: I drink fat-free milk.

questions.question: Rice
questions.exampletranslate: I cook rice with the salmon.

questions.question: Roll / Wrap
questions.exampletranslate: I buy a roll of paper towels.

questions.question: To get / obtain
questions.explanation: 'Saada' (type 2 verb) means to get, receive or obtain; 'saan' is 'I get'.
questions.exampletranslate: May I get a little water?

questions.question: Salad
questions.explanation: 'Salaatti' means salad (also lettuce); its genitive is 'salaatin'.
questions.exampletranslate: I make a green salad.

questions.question: Sauna
questions.exampletranslate: I go to the sauna on Saturday.

questions.question: Pig / Pork
questions.explanation: 'Sika' means pig, and sianliha is pork; its genitive is 'sian'.
questions.exampletranslate: I don't eat pork.

questions.question: Onion
questions.exampletranslate: I chop the onion for the soup.

questions.question: Sugar
questions.exampletranslate: I put sugar in the coffee.

questions.question: Salt
questions.exampletranslate: There is too much salt in the food.

questions.question: Salty
questions.exampletranslate: The soup is too salty.

questions.question: Bread roll
questions.exampletranslate: I eat a roll with cheese.

questions.question: Dill
questions.exampletranslate: I add dill to the fish.

questions.question: Counter / Service desk
questions.explanation: 'Tiski' means a counter or service desk (e.g. a fish counter).
questions.exampletranslate: The fish is at the fish counter.

questions.question: Tomato
questions.exampletranslate: I put tomato in the salad.

questions.question: Tuna
questions.exampletranslate: I buy a can of tuna.

questions.question: Dark
questions.exampletranslate: I like dark chocolate.

questions.question: That
questions.explanation: 'Tuo' means that (over there); its genitive is 'tuon'.
questions.exampletranslate: I'll take that apple.

questions.question: Fresh
questions.exampletranslate: The bread is fresh.

questions.question: Fresh juice
questions.exampletranslate: I drink fresh juice in the morning.

questions.question: Light / Pale
questions.exampletranslate: I buy white (light) bread.

questions.question: Garlic
questions.exampletranslate: I add garlic to the food.

questions.question: Still / Yet
questions.exampletranslate: I still need milk.

questions.question: Vegetable
questions.explanation: 'Vihannes' means vegetable; its genitive is 'vihanneksen' (a synonym of 'kasvis').
questions.exampletranslate: I eat vegetables every day.

questions.question: Butter
questions.exampletranslate: I put butter on the bread.

questions.question: Queue number / Turn number
questions.explanation: 'Vuoronumero' means a queue or turn number (a ticket showing your turn).
questions.exampletranslate: I take a queue number at the counter.
